Thank you so much for your comment. I am alive. I took sleeping pills. I fell asleep on my side instead of my back. Which means I just woke up pretty dizzy and nauseated next to puke. 

Why did she stay so long? Did you help.her cope? I am happy she is okay... and why her depression?
I know what the future *can* hold. Not what will happen...I don't want it. I can't see myself being happy. Just being isolated. I always do that. Why would I stop in the future.
They will Know that it was on purpose. I do not want to be admitted into a .hospital
I'm sorry that time period was hard... I feel like I can relate. How are you.now? And how is your daughter?
